records.reason: Rub your hands together to lather up the soap中lather up the soap及语义焦点生硬，常用说法是lather up with soap或work up a lather。
records.suggested_fix: 改为Rub your hands together with soap until they lather up.／双手抹上肥皂搓出泡沫。搭配保留lather up with soap。
records.source_based_reason: lather up the soap is understandable but less idiomatic than lather up with soap or work up a lather; classify as naturalness issue, not false sense.

records.reason: towel-dry只说明用毛巾擦去水分，不必然意味着恰好‘半干’；中文源义与答案释义过窄。
records.suggested_fix: 请求CG-MASTER调整源中文释义为‘用毛巾擦干（头发）／吸去头发多余水分’，作者同步修订meaning_zh。
records.source_based_reason: towel-dry has no fixed half-dry endpoint. Author gloss 半干 over-specifies degree.
records.next_action: Master scope approval: 用毛巾擦去头发上的水分.

records.reason: usage_note声称moisturizer通常不可数不准确；moisturizer常作可数名词，如a moisturizer, a good moisturizer，也可用于不可数量词。
records.suggested_fix: 改为moisturizer可数或不可数，如a moisturizer / apply moisturizer / use a gentle moisturizer；不要断言通常不可数。
records.source_based_reason: Moisturizer is normally countable in 'a moisturizer' and often mass-like without determiner in 'apply moisturizer'; '通常不可数' excludes common use.
records.next_action: Replace note with 可数或不可数 and examples.
